claims.citation: New York Herald, 19 August 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Bark J B Hea[?] (of Windsor, NS), Folker, Marseilles, Mar
31, and Gibraltar, July 8, with mdse, to Baetjer & De Vertu.
Was anchored off Gibraltar 21 days; have had strong N and
NE winds the last 9 days, carried away maintop gallant yard;
16th inst, lat 39 40, lon 72 19, spoke bark Rosara, bound E.
